record.question: 7 of the top 10 most polluted cities in the World are in ________.
record.explanation: Answer C: India. The 2018 IQAir/AirVisual World Air Quality Report’s most polluted city ranking places seven of its top ten cities in India; the stem appears to refer to that report rather than an unqualified all-time statistic. Reference: https://www.iqair.com/dl/pdf-reports/world-most-polluted-cities-2018-en.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
